anomaly_definition: Each dataset's own 365-day daily climatology removed.
lag1_definition: Pearson lag-1 autocorrelation of daily anomalies.
event_threshold_definition: Cell-wise p90/p10 of ALADIN/RCM daily anomalies over SSP3-7.0 2015-2100.
threshold_application: Same ALADIN/RCM threshold applied to RCM, E2 v2 and U-Net.
warm_event: Consecutive days with daily anomaly > RCM p90 threshold.
cold_event: Consecutive days with daily anomaly < RCM p10 threshold.
note: Persistence diagnostic; not presented as a formal ETCCDI heatwave/cold-spell index.
